carnival-horizon.title: Carnival Horizon Cruise Ship: Vista Class, 2018
carnival-horizon.description: Carnival Horizon is a Vista-class cruise ship from 2018, sister to Carnival Vista. Carnival lists 133,500 gross tons and 3,960 guests. CDC score 95.
carnival-horizon.lead: Carnival Horizon is a Vista-class cruise ship. Fincantieri, the builder, calls it a sister to Carnival Vista and lists delivery in 2018. Carnival's ship page and fact sheet both list 133,500 gross tons, a guest capacity of 3,960, and 1,450 crew.
paragraphs: Fincantieri's product page says 133,500 tons in the introduction and prints 133,596 in the specification table on the same page. Carnival's public figure is 133,500. Use Carnival's number for the line's capacity claims, and treat 133,596 as the builder's table figure.
Carnival.com lists length as 1,055 feet. Fincantieri lists length overall as 323.4 meters. This page does not convert one into the other.
Fincantieri lists 1,987 passenger cabins and a maximum of 6,538 persons on board. That persons figure is larger than Carnival's guest capacity of 3,960. Do not read 6,538 as double occupancy.
This page uses those published pages and the CDC green sheet. It does not describe a sailing we took.

sections.heading: Entertainment
paragraphs: The same page names the theater, water park, and adult areas below. It also says the ship has three age-specific youth spaces.

sections.heading: Cabins
paragraphs: Carnival sorts staterooms into interior, ocean view, balcony, and suite headings, then repeats many of them as Havana, Cloud 9 Spa, or Family Harbor versions. Havana headings say guests must be 12 or older. Family Harbor headings list a lounge, kids-eat-free at most specialty restaurants, and one evening of Night Owls babysitting. Cloud 9 headings list thermal-suite access and priority spa bookings. The page does not print square footage in those headings.

Fincantieri's cabin table, which is a count rather than a name list, shows 729 standard inside cabins, 883 balcony cabins, 64 window cabins, 215 window deluxe and family cabins, 49 suites, 8 penthouse suites, and 25 fully accessible cabins.

msc-poesia.title: MSC Poesia Cruise Ship: 2026 Yacht Club Refit
msc-poesia.description: MSC Poesia is a Musica-class cruise ship. An Apr 2026 dry dock added the Yacht Club before Alaska sailings from Seattle. CDC score on this page is 97.
msc-poesia.lead: MSC Poesia is a Musica-class cruise ship. MSC's 15 Apr 2026 release says she is the second of the four Musica-class ships through a Palumbo Malta dry dock, after MSC Magnifica. The same release says the work added the MSC Yacht Club before Alaska sailings from Seattle.
paragraphs: MSC's technical sheet lists 92,627 gross tons, 16 decks including 13 for guests, length 293.80 meters, beam 32.20 meters, height 59.64 meters, and a maximum speed of 23 knots. It lists 3,223 passengers, 1,275 cabins, and about 987 crew.

MSC's public ship pages do not agree with each other, or with that sheet, on the head count. The Canada page lists 3,013 passengers, about 987 crew, and 1,229 cabins. The Australia page lists 3,223 passengers, about 1,039 crew, and 1,223 cabins. An earlier version of this page listed 2,550 guests at double occupancy. That figure is not on these current MSC pages. Do not use 2,550.
Suite counts also disagree. The 15 Apr 2026 release says 69 Yacht Club suites. The Canada and Australia pages say 63 suites, available from 23 Apr 2026. Confirm the count in the booking flow.
This database still lists 2008 as the in-service year. The technical sheet and the April 2026 release do not restate a delivery year, so this page does not treat 2008 as a freshly checked fact.
This page uses MSC's documents and the CDC green sheet. It does not describe a sailing we took.

freedom-of-the-seas.description: Freedom of the Seas is a Freedom-class Royal Caribbean cruise ship from 2006, listing 3,934 guests. Summer 2027 Miami sailings move to Southampton.
freedom-of-the-seas.h1: Freedom of the Seas cruise ship
freedom-of-the-seas.lead: Freedom of the Seas is a Freedom-class Royal Caribbean cruise ship that entered service in 2006. This database lists 3,934 guests at double occupancy, up to 4,515 guests, and 15 decks.
paragraphs: This database says the ship is redeploying to Southampton for summer 2027 after more than 20 Miami sailings were cancelled. The guide that carries that claim cites The Independent and the New York Post.

A review on this site says Freedom sails primarily out of Miami, and that Southampton sailings have run Baltic itineraries. That review is a Cruise Critic roundup. It is not a sailing log. This page does not repeat its prices.
This page does not describe a sailing we took.

facts.value: Southampton redeployment after cancelled Miami sailings

carnival-jubilee.title: Carnival Jubilee Cruise Ship: Galveston Short Trips
carnival-jubilee.description: Carnival Jubilee is an Excel-class Carnival cruise ship in service since 2023. Carnival added regular 4- and 5-day Galveston cruises for 2028-29.
carnival-jubilee.lead: Carnival Jubilee is an Excel-class Carnival Cruise Line ship. This database lists it in service since 2023. It does not list a guest count.
paragraphs: Carnival's 17 Sep 2026 release opened 2028-29 Galveston bookings with Jubilee's first regular four- and five-day sailings from Texas. Four-day Cozumel trips leave select Thursdays from 27 Apr 2028. Five-day Cozumel and Progreso trips leave select Saturdays and Mondays from 17 Apr 2028 through April 2029.
That release is about the 2028-29 season. This page does not turn it into a claim that Galveston is the ship's only home port today.
